name: DueOrphanPurgeV1
selection: keyset-select ORPHAN_PENDING_PURGE rows with purge_due_utc_ms<=now ordered by due,communication_id; bounded batch; selection is advisory only
per_communication: open LLD-01 UnitOfWork and reread retention revision/state/due
revalidate current active communication links and every active protection hold using indexed reads
if any dependency exists, transition back to RETAINED/cancel purge and audit safe result
if due changed/not reached, return NO_CHANGE
capture minimized purge evidence/fingerprints needed by retention history; never copy body/subject/participant/attachment names into purge record
delete attachment chunks/metadata, participants, FTS row, body and subject; set communications.content_state=PURGED and retention state=PURGED with revision increments
safety: external PST/OST is never opened for purge
MSG files, portable exports and existing backups are never deleted/modified
operational entities, link/proposal/event/audit history and frozen terminal summaries remain
crash before commit leaves content intact; committed purge is idempotent on restart
housekeeping scheduler runs even when communication fetching is disabled
